englishTranslation: Chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili
atAGlance: Gà xào sả ớt is chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, usually with sả, onion, rice, and a fish-sauce-and-garlic glaze.
whatItIs: Gà xào sả ớt is chicken stir-fried with lemongrass, chili, garlic, onion, and fish-sauce seasoning. It is fragrant, spicy, and best with rice.
howToEnjoy: Eat with rice so the lemongrass-chili seasoning has balance. Ask for less chili if you want the citrusy sả aroma to lead.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà xào sả ớt when you want a lemongrass-chili wok dish, not fried chicken. Ask for less spice before cooking if you need less heat.
worthKnowing: Sả ớt is one of Vietnam’s great flavor combinations: lemongrass fragrance first, chili heat second.
goodToKnow: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
travelerCaution: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà xào sả ớt.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht fuhn gah sow sah uht
